mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tenants (id, tenant_key, name, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantKey}, #{name}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenants WHERE name = #{name})
SELECT id, tenant_key, name, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.tenants WHERE status = 'PROVISIONING' AND created_at < #{olderThan}
